_doc: Roupas de titulo/cosmetico. id = outfit_id (TitleDef.outfit_id / cosmetico de corpo). prompt = descricao da roupa (ingles, vai para a IA). seeds = sementes tentadas por pose-chave (a melhor silhueta vence).

title_machete.title: pindorama_blade_machete
title_machete.prompt: a sword apprentice outfit: a short sleeveless tunic of rough steel-gray canvas with a small hood folded on the shoulders, worn over a light cream linen shirt with short sleeves, a wide dark brown leather belt with an amber-orange brass buckle and a sheathed machete in a leather scabbard on the left hip, a cloth bandage wrapped around one forearm, dark gray trousers and brown leather boots, fingerless brown leather gloves. No backpack.

title_firefly.title: pindorama_arcane_firefly
title_firefly.prompt: an arcane apprentice outfit: a short deep indigo cape with the hood lowered on the shoulders, over a knee-length indigo tunic with lime-green trim, three small glowing yellow-green firefly pendants hanging from the cape collar, a thin rope belt with a small leather herb pouch with green leaves, dark gray trousers and soft brown boots, bare hands. No backpack.

title_aroeira.title: pindorama_blade_aroeira
title_aroeira.prompt: a defender outfit: a thick quilted padded gambeson jacket in bark brown with vertical stitching, rounded wooden shoulder guards strapped on both shoulders, a moss-green cloth sash tied around the waist, dark brown trousers, sturdy leather boots and brown leather gloves. No backpack.

title_jaguar.title: pindorama_blade_jaguar
title_jaguar.prompt: a fierce hunter outfit: a sleeveless ochre-yellow leather vest with small scattered dark brown jaguar rosette spots, over a dark brown short-sleeved shirt, leather bracers on both forearms, a black cloth sash knotted at the waist with hanging ends, dark trousers and brown boots. No backpack.

title_crystal.title: pindorama_arcane_crystal
title_crystal.prompt: a crystal guardian outfit: a knee-length pale ice-blue overcoat with a tall stiff high collar and silver-gray trim, small faceted pale violet crystal plates on both shoulders, a violet belt, dark gray trousers and gray boots, light gray gloves. No backpack.

title_boitata.title: pindorama_arcane_boitata
title_boitata.prompt: a fire mage outfit: a long midnight-blue mantle coat reaching below the knees, its lower hem decorated with bright orange flame shapes, an orange waist sash with a round stylized orange eye emblem, dark blue trousers and black boots, bare hands. No backpack.

title_ember.title: pindorama_hybrid_ember
title_ember.prompt: a battle mage outfit: a charcoal-gray canvas coat reaching mid-thigh with glowing ember-orange stitching and trim, a short half cape of dark red cloth over one shoulder, a leather belt with a sheathed machete on the hip, dark trousers and brown boots, dark leather gloves. No backpack.

title_cerrado.title: pindorama_bow_cerrado
title_cerrado.name: Flecha do Cerrado
title_cerrado.prompt: an archer outfit: a short sleeveless jerkin of raw undyed light tan leather with visible stitching, worn over a faded olive-green short-sleeved shirt, a sash of woven golden straw wrapped around the waist, a tall cylindrical quiver made of bamboo cane holding a few fletched arrows strapped diagonally on the back with a leather strap across the chest, a leather bracer on each forearm, khaki knee trousers with cloth wraps on the calves and brown boots. No backpack.

title_brejo.title: pindorama_bow_brejo
title_brejo.name: Tocaia do Brejo
title_brejo.prompt: a swamp ambusher outfit: a ragged cape of layered dark green leaves and flakes of dried gray-brown mud draped over the shoulders and hanging to mid-thigh with a jagged hem, a lowered hood of woven dry straw resting on the upper back and shoulders, a mud-brown tunic with moss-green patches, dark olive trousers wrapped with strips of cloth, mud-stained brown boots, dark green cloth wraps on the hands. No backpack.

title_gaviao.title: pindorama_bow_gaviao
title_gaviao.name: Gavião-Real
title_gaviao.prompt: a falconer marksman outfit: a fitted cream-white coat reaching mid-thigh with dark slate-gray trim, big layered pauldrons of gray and white hawk feathers on both shoulders, a sash of small striped gray and white feathers across the chest, a thick long brown leather falconry gauntlet up to the elbow on one arm, a slate-gray belt, gray trousers and tall dark gray boots. No backpack.

title_root.title: pindorama_support_root
title_root.name: Raiz do Cerrado
title_root.prompt: a folk herbalist outfit: a long dark brown canvas apron reaching below the knees over a mustard-yellow long-sleeved blouse, the apron has several front pockets stuffed with green herb sprigs, a knitted terracotta-red shawl draped over both shoulders, two long necklaces of big round red and black seeds, a small corked glass bottle of green liquid hanging from the belt at the waist, brown trousers and simple brown shoes. No backpack.

title_buriti.title: pindorama_support_buriti
title_buriti.name: Seiva do Buriti
title_buriti.prompt: a healer outfit: a knee-length light straw-beige tunic woven from palm fiber with a visible basket-weave texture, a wide bright leaf-green sash at the waist, the hem of the tunic trimmed with a row of small green palm leaf blades, short sleeves over a light cream undershirt, beige trousers and light woven straw sandals with ankle wraps. No backpack.

title_matinta.title: pindorama_support_matinta
title_matinta.name: Assobio da Matinta
title_matinta.prompt: a dark night trickster outfit: a long ragged charcoal-black mantle reaching the ankles with a fringed tattered hem, a mantle collar of layered brown and cream owl feathers covering the shoulders, a lowered dark hood resting on the upper back, long hanging fringes on the sleeves, a dark plum-purple tunic underneath, black trousers and soft black boots. No backpack.

title_jabuti.title: pindorama_tank_jabuti
title_jabuti.name: Casco de Jabuti
title_jabuti.prompt: a tortoise tank outfit: a thick rounded breastplate made of hexagonal shell plates in a tortoise shell pattern, dark brown plates with yellow-ochre borders, a matching rounded back plate like a tortoise carapace, big rounded dome-shaped shell pauldrons on both shoulders, a thick dark green padded undershirt, olive trousers, heavy brown boots and brown leather gloves. No backpack.

title_anta.title: pindorama_tank_anta
title_anta.name: Couro de Anta
title_anta.prompt: a heavy warrior outfit: bulky armor of thick dark gray-brown leather in overlapping horizontal layered bands covering the torso, layered leather shoulder guards, a very wide leather belt with a big square iron buckle, a short skirt of layered leather tassets over the thighs, thick leather greaves on the shins, heavy dark boots and thick leather gloves. No backpack.

title_mapinguari.title: pindorama_tank_mapinguari
title_mapinguari.name: Fúria do Mapinguari
title_mapinguari.prompt: a berserker outfit: an open sleeveless vest of thick shaggy dark reddish-brown fur with messy tufts, bare chest and bare arms with no shirt underneath, three red claw-scratch stripes painted on each arm and on the chest, bone claws strapped to both forearms with leather bands, a fur-trimmed belt, torn dark brown trousers and fur-wrapped dark boots. No backpack.
